name: positional_category_DOP
description: positional_category values must use DOP namespace or be a valid positional_or_topology_term

name: function_tag_DOF
description: function_tags values must use DOF namespace or be a valid functional_term

name: binding_target_DOT
description: binding_parnter values must use DOT namespace or be a valid binding_target_term

name: topology_not_in_function
description: topology terms must not appear in function_tags

name: function_not_in_topology
description: function tags must not appear in topology_context

name: binding_not_in_function
description: binding-target terms must not appear in function_tags

name: one_protein_one_domain
description: each occurrence must have exactly one protein_accession and one domain_type_id

name: start_less_than_end
description: start position must be strictly less than end position

name: start_end_positive_integers
description: start and end must be positive integers (> 0)

name: blank_primary_keys
description: primary key columns must not be blank

name: duplicate_ids
description: primary key IDs must be unique within each table

name: invalid_namespace_prefixes
description: all IDs must use recognised namespace prefixes

name: copy_number_cv
description: copy_number_property must be in CopyNumberCategory (plain name, DOP:NNNNNN, or DOP:NNNNNN Name)

name: topology_context_cv
description: topology_context must be in positional_or_topology_term (plain name, DOP:NNNNNN, or DOP:NNNNNN Name)

name: proximity_categories_cv
description: proximity_categories must be in positional_or_topology_term (plain name, DOP:NNNNNN, or DOP:NNNNNN Name)
